source: LinkedIn jobs-guest via pinned MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search linkedin-search CLI
design: broad discovery -> overlap/retry -> Job-ID dedupe -> exact detail fetch -> annotate only -> lossless ChatGPT review queue

policy.principle: Do not let code decide job fit after exact-detail retrieval; ChatGPT reviews every verified new candidate

review_candidates.title: Sales Director
review_candidates.description: Company Description Upscend is an AI-powered learning management system (LMS) focused on delivering measurable, guaranteed learning outcomes for organizations and learners. By leveraging advanced artificial intelligence, Upscend personalizes learning paths, optimizes engagement, and ensures that training is effective and scalable. The platform is designed for teams that need reliable, data-driven upskilling and compliance training. Upscend partners with businesses that value innovation, continuous learning, and performance improvement. Role Description The Sales Director at Upscend is a full-time, remote role responsible for leading revenue growth and expanding our customer base. This role oversees the entire sales cycle, from prospecting and qualification to negotiation and closing, with a focus on mid-market and enterprise accounts. Day-to-day responsibilities include managing and coaching the sales team, setting targets, tracking performance, and refining sales processes and playbooks. The Sales Director collaborates closely with marketing, product, and customer success to align go-to-market strategies, improve messaging, and ensure seamless handoffs. This role also involves building strategic partnerships, representing Upscend at virtual events and meetings, and providing feedback on market trends and customer needs to inform product roadmap and positioning. Qualifications Strong Sales and Business Development skills, including pipeline management, account strategy, and closing complex deals. +10 years of B2B sales +5 years of Leadership experience in sales Experience in Sales Operations, with the ability to use CRM tools, analyze sales metrics, and optimize sales processes. Proficiency in Customer Service and relationship management, ensuring high customer satisfaction and long-term retention. Proven Team Management skills, including coaching, performance management, and building a collaborative sales culture. Background selling SaaS or technology solutions, preferably in e-learning, HR tech, or related domains. Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders at multiple levels. Comfort working remotely, with strong self-organization, time management, and cross-functional collaboration abilities. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
review_candidates.verification: Exact LinkedIn jobs-guest jobPosting endpoint returned a job detail page during this run
review_candidates.review_policy: Always pass exact-detail candidate to ChatGPT; closed status, weak keyword evidence, noisy title, or freshness conflict are annotations only
